## 16000 - 16008

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="16000">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />16000 TRANS - Transactions</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="16000">

This exception is a Header exception and will not be generated by FLOWCAL. This group of exceptions has to do with the Transaction Service and potential issues around the import of data via the Transaction Service.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="16001">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />16001 TRANS - Meter was automatically created by transaction processing</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="16001">

This exception is generated when importing a .sql file via the Transaction Service into a FLOWCAL database, and the meter being imported does not exist on the FLOWCAL database.  For the auto-creation to occur, the Service Configuration Option, in the Transaction Queue Options group box, must be enabled for Auto Create Meters. This exception is to let the user know that the meter was automatically created.

</div>

#### 16002 TRANS - History older than (deprecated)

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="16003">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />16003 TRANS - Duplicate history effective date with new data</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="16003">

This exception is generated when a Transaction Queue record is imported for an effective date, and another record with different data is imported on the same meter for the same effective date. In this case FLOWCAL will increment the second imported record by 1 second and both records will be displayed in the Volume editor. Users may see this, for example, if they did not take into account Daylight Savings Time within FLOWCAL and allowed two records to be imported in the Fall when time changes.  

Another example, would be when a user resets time on a Flow Computer.  It is 9:07am on the Flow Computer and a user realizes it’s really 8:57am so they set the time back to 8:57am on the Flow Computer. This would cause two 9am records to be imported and would also generate this exception.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="16004">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />16004 TRANS - Automatically replaced auto estimated data with original</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="16004">

This exception is generated when a Transaction Queue record is imported over auto estimated data. This is to let the user know that that auto estimate service has been overwritten.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="16005">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />16005 TRANS - Inactive meter</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="16005">

This exception is generated when a Transaction Queue record is imported on to an Inactive Meter.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="16006">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />16006 TRANS - Disconnected meter</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="16006">

This exception is generated when a Transaction Queue record is imported on to a Disconnected Meter.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="16007">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />16007 TRANS - Late import of char/analysis caused recalc of original correlation factor (ignore only)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="16007">

Generated by Transaction Queue service imports. If an event or configuration record is received that when applied is applied to a time frame that has existing imported periodic data, the revision 0 correlation factors for all imported records will be recalculated based on the updated meter configuration. (Liquid TQ only.)

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="16008">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />16008 TRANS - Late import of char/analysis caused recalc of revised correlation factor (ignore only)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="16008">

Generated by Transaction Queue service imports. If an event or configuration record is received that when applied is applied to a time frame that has existing periodic data, the correlation factors for all imported records for the most current revision will be recalculated based on the updated meter configuration. (Liquid TQ only.)

</div>
